newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Generali falls two pct in Milan.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Generali falls two pct in Milan.

text.p: Italian insurer Assicurazioni Generali fell around two percent on the Milan stock exchange, extending recent losses in low volume trade.
Generali ordinary shares were quoted 2.1 percent down at 32,550 lire by 1340 GMT.
Traders said insurers in general were suffering from continued rumours the next budget, due to be presented to parliament by the month end, would contain a tax on technical reserves.
However this is not confirmed and others said the stock's weakness was down to arbitrage between cash and futures.
Some said investors were lightening portfolios of insurance stocks on the cash side but buying November call options.
Other insurers were also suffering, with RAS down 2.44 percent at 12,700, Sai off 1.21 percent at 12,200 and Alleanza 1.7 percent weaker at 11,230.
The blue-chip Mib30 index was 0.87 percent lower at 14,030.
